name: Notice of default
what: A written notice that a tenant or a borrower has failed to perform, with the cure period the lease or loan gives.

fields.label: Kind of notice
fields.definition: Whether the notice goes from a landlord to a tenant or from a lender to a borrower.

fields.label: Sent by
fields.definition: The party giving notice and the person who signed it.

fields.label: Sent to
fields.definition: Each party the notice is addressed to, at the address the governing document requires, and any guarantor or copy party it names.

fields.label: Governing document
fields.definition: The lease or loan document the default arises under, by date, and the sections the notice cites.

fields.label: Notice date
fields.definition: The date written on the notice.

fields.label: Delivery method
fields.definition: How the notice was sent, such as hand delivery, certified mail or overnight courier, and whether that method matches the notice clause.

fields.label: Delivered on
fields.definition: The date the notice counts as delivered under the governing document, with the proof, such as a receipt or tracking record.

fields.label: Defaults stated
fields.definition: Each failure the notice describes, monetary or not, in the notice's own terms.

fields.label: Amount due
fields.definition: The total the notice demands, with its parts, such as rent, recoveries, late charges, interest or a missed loan payment; null for a non-monetary default.

fields.label: Cure period
fields.definition: The days the governing document gives to cure after delivery, and whether they are calendar or business days.

fields.label: Cure deadline
fields.definition: The last day to cure, counted from the delivery date as the governing document counts days.

fields.label: Consequences stated
fields.definition: What the notice says will follow if the default is not cured, such as termination, acceleration, a draw on a deposit or letter of credit, or other remedies the document gives.

fields.label: Reservation of rights
fields.definition: Whether the notice states that the sender keeps its other rights and that accepting a partial payment does not waive the default.
